title: Saudi Arabian Sausage Stew
description: A hearty stew originating from Saudi Arabia, made with flavorful sausages and tender chunks of stew meat.
instructions: Brown the sausages in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Remove the sausages from the pot and set them aside.
Add the stew meat to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onions and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the Arabian spices, beef broth, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Return the sausages to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
